decisions.decision: Passed the executor's protocol files (execute-plan.md, summary.md, checkpoints.md, tdd.md, worktree-path-safety.md, executor-examples.md) as a <required_reading> list of absolute paths instead of inlining their ~156 KB of content into the Agent() prompt.
decisions.rationale: execute-phase.md's dispatch template says to inline them verbatim, to avoid #3324 (a bare `@path` line never expands inside an Agent prompt and arrives as dead text). But gsd-executor.md's own definition embeds mandatory-initial-read.md, which hard-requires the agent to Read every file listed in <required_reading> before any other action — so an explicit Read-tool list carries the same guarantee without round-tripping 156 KB through the orchestrator and blowing its ~15% context budget. The executor did read them; all 3 tasks and 7 commits landed correctly.
